rulings.question_text: When this card's [Activate: Main] effect is used, can the cost be paid with DON!! that was just rested this turn?
rulings.ruling_text: Yes. You may use DON!! that was rested this turn to pay the cost for [Activate: Main] as long as it is your turn and the timing is correct.
rulings.normalized_summary: DON!! rested this turn can be used to pay [Activate: Main] cost on your turn.

rulings.question_text: When can I use a Counter event?
rulings.ruling_text: Counter events can be used when your opponent declares an attack, during the timing specified on the card (e.g. "When your opponent's Leader or Character attacks").
rulings.normalized_summary: Counter events are used in response to opponent's attack declaration.
